module_summary: Asynchronous dual-clock FIFO: memory array addressed by binary write/read pointers, Gray-coded pointers crossed via NFF synchronizers to generate full and empty flags, with optional registered read output.

anchors.name: mem
anchors.why: FIFO data array written from i_wr_data at wr_addr, read at rd_addr

anchors.name: wr_addr
anchors.why: Binary write pointer, increments on accepted write, addresses memory write

anchors.name: rd_addr
anchors.why: Binary read pointer, increments on local read, addresses memory read

anchors.name: wgray
anchors.why: Gray-coded write pointer sent to read clock domain synchronizer

anchors.name: rgray
anchors.why: Gray-coded read pointer sent to write clock domain; compared for empty

anchors.name: wr_rgray
anchors.why: Read Gray pointer synchronized into write domain, compared for full flag

anchors.name: rd_wgray
anchors.why: Write Gray pointer synchronized into read domain, compared for empty flag

anchors.name: wgray_cross
anchors.why: Intermediate synchronizer flops carrying wgray into read clock domain

anchors.name: rgray_cross
anchors.why: Intermediate synchronizer flops carrying rgray into write clock domain

anchors.name: o_wr_full
anchors.why: Full flag back-pressures writer; blocks pointer increment and memory write

anchors.name: o_rd_empty
anchors.why: Empty flag to reader, registered from lcl_rd_empty; inverse of read data valid

anchors.name: i_wr
anchors.why: Write request; with !o_wr_full enables memory write and pointer advance

anchors.name: i_wr_data
anchors.why: Incoming write data stored into mem

anchors.name: o_rd_data
anchors.why: Read data output, registered from memory read on lcl_read

anchors.name: lcl_read
anchors.why: Local read enable advancing rd_addr and loading output registers

anchors.name: lcl_rd_empty
anchors.why: Combinational empty compare gating read pointer advance

anchors.name: lcl_rd_data
anchors.why: Asynchronous memory read value feeding o_rd_data

groups.name: FIFO memory
groups.description: Dual-clock storage array written in write domain, read in read domain

groups.name: Write pointer and full logic
groups.description: Write-domain binary/Gray pointer and full comparison against synchronized read pointer

groups.name: Read pointer and empty logic
groups.description: Read-domain pointer, empty compare and registered read output stage

groups.name: Clock domain crossing synchronizers
groups.description: NFF-stage synchronizers crossing Gray pointers between write and read clocks
